query: Add a labels feature: list labels, create one, rename one, delete one. Wire it from a Server Action down to Postgres. Show the application layer.
baseline_failure: RED hypothesis: the agent creates use-cases/labels/labels.ts with four exported functions whose bodies are a single delegation each (return deps.labels.list(), etc.), plus a ports.ts mirroring the four operations, and a test asserting toHaveBeenCalledWith on the fake.
expected_behavior: Applies the deletion test and finds these CRUD operations hold nothing; treats the missing pure middle as a signal, not as the rule
Routes the inbound adapter to the data module directly for the operations that have no application logic
Introduces a use-case only where a rule or orchestration actually appears, and says which one
Places validation and failure normalisation in the boundary declaration rather than per function
anti_expectation: Does NOT delete the application layer wholesale as a general principle
Does NOT move business rules into the inbound adapter to justify skipping the use-case
Does NOT keep a use-case file that only re-exports the data module
